$comment: Single source of truth for every identifier that has to agree across this
repository. It exists because the same class of bug kept recurring: a
Cloudflare account id, a Worker name or a workers.dev hostname was typed by
hand into one file, drifted from what was actually deployed, and nothing
noticed until the site had been dead for hours.
Nothing reads these values at runtime. scripts/check-config.mjs asserts that
wrangler.jsonc, worker/wrangler.jsonc and the workflows under .github/
still match them, and CI runs that check before it is allowed to deploy.
Change a name here and the check tells you every file that has to follow.
Not a secret, and deliberately not a GitHub Secret. Supabase publishable
keys are designed to be shipped in browser code; this one grants exactly
what an anonymous visitor already has -- read access to published
articles, bounded by row-level security. Treating it as a secret bought
nothing and cost a manual step on every environment.
The site reads with this. The generator writes with SUPABASE_WRITE_KEY,
which is a real secret and lives only in GitHub Secrets.

requiredSecrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: Scoped Workers-edit token for the account above. Deploys nothing without it.
requiredSecrets.SUPABASE_WRITE_KEY: service_role key. The generator inserts rows; the publishable key cannot.

optionalSecrets.UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY: Article imagery. Without it the generator falls back to government photo feeds.
optionalSecrets.RESEND_API_KEY: Newsletter delivery. Without it /subscribe stores the address and sends nothing.
